name: Bloodlust
changeNote: Healing doesn't expend the rolled hit die.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Powerful Recovery
entries: When you roll a {@rule Hit Point Dice|Hit Point Die} to regain {@rule Hit Points}, you can treat any roll of 1 or 2 as a 3.

entries.name: Sanguine Feast
entries: Once per turn when you hit a {@status Bloodied} creature that isn't a Construct or Undead with an attack roll, you can roll a {@rule Hit Point Dice|Hit Point Die} (the die isn't expended), and regain a number of {@rule Hit Points} equal to the number rolled plus your Constitution modifier.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Cloying Mists
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Arise, Fog
entries: You always have the {@spell Fog Cloud} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot and you maybe use a {@rule Bonus Action} instead of an action to cast it when you cast it this way. You must finish a {@rule Long Rest} before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

Whenever you cast {@spell Fog Cloud}, nonmagical flames in the spell's {@rule Sphere [Area of Effect]|Sphere} are extinguished. While inside the cloud, you have {@sense Blindsight} out to 10 feet. Additionally creatures other than you and your allies have their {@rule Speed} reduced by 10 feet while inside it.

changeNote: Allow one {@spell Fog Cloud} casting as a Bonus Action, increase the slow to 10-ft for enemies, and grant 10-ft Blindsight inside your own fog.

name: Lightbringer
changeNote: Healing doesn't expend the rolled hit die.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Sacred Magic
entries: You learn the {@spell Light} spell and can cast it without Material components. If you already know that cantrip, you learn a different Cleric cantrip of your choice. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Solar Luminance
entries: When you cast {@spell Light}, you can have the light from the spell be sunlight for 10 minutes; if any of its Bright Light overlaps with an area of magical darkness created by a spell of level 2 or lower (level 3 or lower at character level 11), that darkness is dispelled. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Sun's Healing
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action} while within sunlight, choose yourself or one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself that is in sunlight. The target regains {@rule Hit Points} equal to the roll of one of your {@rule Hit Point Dice} (the die isn't expended) plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Treacherous Allure
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Enchanting Presence
entries: You always have the {@spell Charm Person} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you must finish a {@rule Long Rest} before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Creatures don't gain {@rule Advantage} on their saving throw against your {@spell Charm Person} spell simply because you or your allies are fighting them. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Inevitable Betrayal
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on attack rolls against creatures with the {@condition Charmed} condition. Once per turn when you hit a {@condition Charmed} creature with an attack roll, the attack deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Psychic damage, and the target can't take {@rule Reaction|Reactions} until the start of your next turn.

changeNote: Remove combat Advantage penalty on Charm Person and upgrade Inevitable Betrayal with extra 2d6 Psychic damage and Reaction denial.

name: Monster Hunter
changeNote: Allow ward to affect allies and give an actual {@i hunter} effect to the 'Hunter' feat.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Adroit Escape
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on checks and saving throws to avoid or escape the {@condition Grappled} condition, and you can make a check to escape a grapple as a {@rule Bonus Action}.

entries.name: Sanctified Ward
entries: When you or a creature you can see within 10 feet of you takes Necrotic or Poison damage, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to reduce that damage by {@dice 1d8} plus your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}. You can use this {@rule Reaction} a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Prepared Hunter
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item Woodcarver's Tools}. When you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, you can bless a weapon or bundle of ammunition. Once per turn when you hit an Aberration, Fiend, Monstrosity, or Undead with a blessed weapon or piece of ammunition, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Radiant damage and prevent the target from regaining {@rule Hit Points} until the start of your next turn. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Vampire Touched
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Vampire Magic
entries: Choose one level 1 spell from the Enchantment or Illusion school of magic. You always have that spell and the {@spell Spider Climb} spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells once without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a {@rule Long Rest} before you can cast each spell in this way again. You can also cast either spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. When you cast {@spell Spider Climb} targeting yourself, it doesn't require {@status Concentration}. Your spellcasting ability for the spells is the ability increased by this feat.

changeNote: Remove self-only limit on free Spider Climb and make Spider Climb concentration-free when cast on yourself so it competes with Fey-Touched and Shadow-Touched.

name: Former Captive
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Emergency Tincture
entries: When you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, you can create one {@item Potion of Healing} or an {@item Antitoxin}, as long as you have an empty {@item vial} or {@item flask}. These liquids evaporate when you finish another {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Slip the Leash
entries: You can take a {@rule Bonus Action} to take the {@action Dash} action or the {@action Disengage} action. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you recover all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Lingering Tether
entries: Work with your DM to determine the nature and fate of your former master (such as a hag, archfey, dark mage, mind flayer, fiend, or vampire). While you and your former master are on the same plane of existence, they can communicate with you telepathically, and you can choose to allow them to perceive through your senses.

name: Adept of Abjuration
changeNote: Changed the spells to all be actual Abjuration spells as I classify them. Probably a slight buff overall, but not a big one.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Abjuration Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Protective Ward
entries: When you cast a spell from the Abjuration school using a spell slot, you or one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself gains {@rule Temporary Hit Points} equal to twice the level of spell slot expended.

name: Arcane Artist
changeNote: Add a larger illusion and scale inspiration up to PB per long rest.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Minor Illusion} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Stage Illusions
entries: When you cast {@spell Minor Illusion} the image can fill a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} instead of a 5-foot one.

entries.name: Inspiring Magic
entries: When you cast a spell from the Illusion school, you can choose one ally within 30 feet of yourself who can see you. That ally gains {@rule Heroic Inspiration}. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, but no more than once per turn, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Arcane Eloquence
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Vicious Mockery} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Smooth Talker
entries: When you make a Charisma ({@skill Deception}, {@skill Intimidation}, or {@skill Persuasion}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

name: Arcane Infiltrator
changeNote: Allow the possibility to get away with using Friends without being noticed.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Friends} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Subtle Charm
entries: You can cast {@spell Friends} without Verbal or Somatic components. When the spell ends, the target doesn't realize it was charmed by magic unless it succeeds on a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check against your spell save DC.

entries.name: Cunning Diversion
entries: You can take the {@action Dodge} action as a {@rule Bonus Action}. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Arcane Omens
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Guidance} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Helpful Premonition
entries: When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself fails a saving throw, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the save's total, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Arcane Overload
changeNote: Small ribbon to change Fire Bolt damage type, and move to PB per LR instead of just once per LR.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Fire Bolt} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Elemental Shift
entries: When you cast {@spell Fire Bolt}, you can change its damage type to Cold or Lightning.

entries.name: Power Surge
entries: When you cast an Evocation spell and deal damage with it, you can add your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} to one damage roll of that spell. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, but no more than once per turn, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Arcane Safeguard
changeNote: Allow bonus action Resistance without concentration (one at a time).
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Resistance} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Quick Ward
entries: You can cast the {@spell Resistance} cantrip as a {@rule Bonus Action}. When you do so, the spell doesn't require {@status Concentration} and lasts for its full duration. Casting it this way again ends any earlier concentration-free casting. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Sheltering Aid
entries: When you take the {@action Help} action to assist with an ally's ability check or attack roll, that ally gains a number of {@rule Temporary Hit Points} equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}.

name: Arcane Undertaker
changeNote: Allow Bonus Action stabilize, trigger Understanding of Death on healing a 0 HP ally as well as stabilizing, and grant Temp HP to both of you.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn one Cleric or Wizard cantrip of your choice. The cantrip must be from the Necromancy school. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Knowledge from the Dead
entries: When you make an Intelligence ({@skill History}) or Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Understanding of Death
entries: You can take the {@action Help} action to stabilize a creature with 0 {@rule Hit Points} as a {@rule Bonus Action}. Additionally, when you stabilize a creature with 0 {@rule Hit Points} or restore {@rule Hit Points} to a creature that has 0 {@rule Hit Points}, you gain {@rule Heroic Inspiration} if you lack it, and both you and that creature gain {@rule Temporary Hit Points} equal to twice your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}. Once you gain these benefits, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Adept of Conjuration
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Conjuration Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Persistent Conjuration
entries: While maintaining {@status Concentration} on a spell from the Conjuration school, you gain a bonus to Constitution saving throws to maintain this {@status Concentration}. This bonus is equal to the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat.

name: Adept of Divination
changeNote: Detect Magic instead of {@spell Detect Otherworldly Influence}, which is kind of niche.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Divination Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Prescient Intervention
entries: When a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself makes a {@rule D20 Test}, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to give that creature {@rule Advantage} or {@rule Disadvantage} (your choice) on that roll.
Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also regain use of this feature when you cast a spell from the Divination school using a spell slot.

name: Elemental Familiar
changeNote: Save for half on damage pulse and scale damage at levels 11 and 17.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Elemental Energy
entries: You learn how to imbue your familiar with elemental power. When you cast the {@spell Find Familiar} spell, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. Your familiar is imbued with this energy until you cast {@spell Find Familiar} again, granting it the following benefits:

entries.name: Elemental Resistance
entries: Your familiar has {@rule Resistance} to the chosen damage type.

entries.name: Energy Pulse
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you command your familiar to unleash a burst of elemental energy. Your familiar must be within 120 feet of you and take a {@rule Reaction} to unleash this burst. Each creature in a 5-foot {@rule Emanation [Area of Effect]|Emanation} originating from your familiar makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier for the {@spell Find Familiar} spell and your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d4} damage of the chosen type, and if the creature is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Prone} condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall {@condition Prone}. The damage increases to {@damage 3d4} at level 11 and {@damage 4d4} at level 17.

name: Adept of Enchantment
changeNote: Alter spells to be slightly better. Fear, Charm Monster, and Synaptic Static instead of {@spell Hold Person}, {@spell Dominate Beast} and {@spell Modify Memory}
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Enchantment Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Subtle Enchantments
entries: When you cast a spell from the Enchantment school using a spell slot, you can cast it without any Verbal, Somatic, or Material components, except Material components that are consumed by the spell or that have a cost specified in the spell.

name: Adept of Evocation
changeNote: Tactical spell list swap (replacing Fireball/Wall of Force) and add spell slot level to Fueled Evocation damage to match Necromancy Adept.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Evocation Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Fueled Evocation
entries: Once per turn when you cast an Evocation spell using a spell slot and deal damage, you can roll up to two of your unexpended {@rule Hit Point Dice} and add the total rolled plus the level of the spell slot expended to one of the spell's damage rolls. Those {@rule Hit Point Dice} are then expended.

name: Familiar Friend
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Faithful Companion
entries: You always have the {@spell Find Familiar} spell prepared. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can cast it once without a spell slot or Material components, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

entries.name: Fortified Familiar
entries: When you cast the {@spell Find Familiar} spell, your familiar's {@rule Hit Points|Hit Point} maximum and current {@rule Hit Points} are increased by an amount equal to twice your character level.

entries.name: Helpful Friend
entries: When you make an ability check using a skill in which you have proficiency while your familiar is within 5 feet of you, you gain {@rule Advantage} on the check. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Adept of Illusion
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Illusion Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Masterful Illusions
entries: When you cast a spell from the Illusion school using a spell slot, you can cast it without any Verbal, Somatic, or Material components, except Material components that are consumed by the spell or that have a cost specified in the spell. Additionally, creatures have {@rule Disadvantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks made to discern the true nature of illusions created by your spells.

name: Magic Connoisseur
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Choose a level 1 and a level 2 spell from the same list you selected for the Magic Initiate feat's cantrips. You always have those spells prepared. You can cast each spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spellcasting ability for these spells is the same as the spellcasting ability chosen for your Magic Initiate feat's spells.

entries.name: Spell Change
entries: Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose for this feat with a different spell of the same level from the chosen spell list.

name: Adept of Necromancy
changeNote: Split into Death/Life paths, small spell swaps, and allow Life Manipulation to heal yourself or an ally within 30 feet.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. Choose either "Death" or "Life". When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Necromancy Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed in that column for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Life Manipulation
entries: When you cast a spell from the Necromancy school using a spell slot, you can immediately roll up to two of your unexpended {@rule Hit Point Dice}. You or one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself regains {@rule Hit Points} equal to the total rolled plus the level of the spell slot expended. Those {@rule Hit Point Dice} are then expended.

name: Portal Jumper
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Otherworldly Resilience
entries: You have {@rule Resistance} to one of the following damage types: Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Portal Step
entries: You can spend 15 feet of movement to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of yourself. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} but only once per turn, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Spell Resistant
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Magical Resilience
entries: You have {@rule Resistance} to one of the following damage types (choose when you gain this feat): Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder.

entries.name: Magic Resistant
entries: When you would fail a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, you can roll {@dice 1d6} and add the number rolled to the save's total, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Spell Subterfuge
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shrouding Spells
entries: After you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action using a spell slot, you can take both the {@action Dash} and {@action Hide} actions as a {@rule Bonus Action}. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Sneaky Casting
entries: If you have the {@action Hide} action's {@condition Invisible} condition, casting a spell with a Verbal component or making a spell attack doesn't end that condition on you if you end the turn behind {@rule Cover|Three-Quarters Cover} or {@rule Cover|Total Cover}.

name: Adept of Transmutation
changeNote: Allow Magical Augmentation to target yourself or an ally within 30 feet, ignore Opportunity Attacks, and last until the end of the target's next turn.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Transmutation Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Magical Augmentation
entries: When you cast a spell from the Transmutation school using a spell slot, you or one willing creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself increases its {@rule Speed} by a number of feet equal to 5 times the level of the spell slot expended and doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|Opportunity Attacks}. This benefit lasts until the end of that creature's next turn.

name: Transmuted Anatomy
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Lengthened Stride
entries: Your {@rule Speed} increases by 5 feet.

entries.name: Resilient Anatomy
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on saving throws against effects that would compel you to shape-shift against your will. Additionally, when you fail a Constitution saving throw, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the save, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Warlike Familiar
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Battle Familiar
entries: You always have the {@spell Battle Familiar} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the one chosen for the Faithful Companion benefit of your Familiar Friend feat.

entries.name: Intercept Attack
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of your familiar is hit by an attack roll, your familiar can take a {@rule Reaction} to add a bonus equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} to the creature's {@rule Armor Class} against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss.

name: Primeval Ember of Fire
entries: You've manifested the fiery combat emblematic of fire giants, granting you the following benefits:

entries.name: Born of Flame
entries: You have resistance to fire damage.

entries.name: Searing Ignition
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can replace a single attack with a magical burst of flame. Each creature of your choice in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on you must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the ability increased by this feat). On a failed save, a creature takes fire damage equal to {@damage 1d8} + your proficiency bonus, and it has the blinded condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. You can use your Searing Ignition a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus (but no more than once per turn), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Primeval Fury of Frost
entries: You've manifested the icy might emblematic of frost giants, granting you the following benefits:

entries.name: Born of Ice
entries: You have resistance to cold damage.

entries.name: Frigid Retaliation
entries: Immediately after a creature you can see within 30 feet of you hits you with an attack roll and deals damage, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to retaliate with a conjured blast of ice. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw (DC equals 8 + your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} + the modifier of the ability increased by this feat). On a failed save, the creature takes Cold damage equal to {@damage 1d8} + your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and its {@rule Speed} is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. You can use this {@rule Reaction} a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Add half damage on a successful save to Frigid Retaliation to match Primeval Ember of Fire.

name: Primeval Guile of Clouds
entries: You've manifested the confounding magic emblematic of cloud giants, granting you the following benefits:

entries.name: Cloudy Escape
entries: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to that attack's damage. You then teleport to an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet of yourself. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Primeval Keenness of Stone
entries: You've manifested the physical talents emblematic of stone giants, granting you the following benefits:

entries.name: Cavernous Sight
entries: You gain {@sense darkvision} with a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense darkvision} from another source, its range increases by 60 feet.

entries.name: Stone Throw
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you can take a rock and make a magical attack with it. The attack is a ranged spell attack with a range of 60 feet that uses the ability score you increased with this feat as the spellcasting ability. On a hit, the rock deals Force damage equal to {@damage 1d10} + your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC equals 8 + your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} + the spellcasting ability modifier) or have the {@condition Prone} condition. You can use this {@rule Bonus Action} a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Add Proficiency Bonus to Stone Throw damage so it scales competitively with the other Primeval feats.

name: Rune Shaper
changeNote: Make available as an origin feat; keep prepared rune spells, but limit free invocation to one rune per Long Rest.
entries: You've studied the magic of Giant runes, granting you the following benefits:

entries.name: Comprehend Languages
entries: You learn the {@spell comprehend languages} spell. You can cast this spell without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have.

entries.name: Rune Magic
entries: You know a number of runes equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down), chosen from the Rune Spells table. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can inscribe each rune you know onto one nonmagical weapon, armor, piece of clothing, or other object you touch. You temporarily learn the 1st-level spells that correspond to the runes you inscribed, as specified on the Rune Spells table, and you know those spells until you finish a long rest, when the runes fade. While you are wearing or carrying any rune-marked object, you can cast the spells associated with those runes using any spell slots you have.

Once per {@rule Long Rest}, you can invoke one rune inscribed on an object you are wearing or carrying and cast its associated spell without expending a spell slot or using material components. Your spellcasting ability for this feat is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).
Each time you gain a level, you can replace one of the runes you know with another one from the Rune Spells table.

name: Primeval Soul of Storms
entries: You've manifested the tempest magic emblematic of storm giants, granting you the following benefits:

entries.name: Maelstrom Aura
entries: As a bonus action, you surround yourself with an aura of magical wind and lightning that extends 10 feet from you in every direction but not through total cover. The aura lasts until the start of your next turn or until you are incapacitated. While the aura is active, you have resistance to lightning and thunder damage. In addition, attack rolls against you have disadvantage, and whenever another creature starts its turn within the aura, you can force the creature to make a Strength saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the ability increased by this feat). On a failed save, the creature's speed is halved until the start of its next turn. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Primeval Strike
changeNote: Make available as an origin feat.
entries: You have absorbed primeval magic that gives you an echo of the might of giants. When you take this feat, choose one of the benefits listed below. Once per turn, when you hit a target with a melee weapon attack or a ranged weapon attack using a thrown weapon, you can imbue the attack with an additional effect depending on the benefit you chose:

entries.name: Cloud Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d4} thunder damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or you become invisible to it until the start of your next turn or until immediately after you make an attack roll or cast a spell.

entries.name: Fire Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d10} fire damage.

entries.name: Frost Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} cold damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or its speed is reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Hill Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the weapon's type. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

entries.name: Stone Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet from you in a straight line.

entries.name: Storm Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.
The saving throw DC for these effects equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Constitution modifier.
You can use this feat a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Primeval Vigor of Hills
entries: You've manifested the resilience emblematic of hill giants, granting you the following benefits:

entries.name: Bulwark
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on ability checks and saving throws to avoid being moved against your will or knocked {@condition Prone}. Additionally, when you are subjected to an effect that would move you at least 5 feet or give you the {@condition Prone} condition, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to steady yourself; you aren't moved and don't gain the {@condition Prone} condition.

entries.name: Iron Stomach
entries: You have {@rule Resistance} to Poison damage and {@rule Advantage} on saving throws against the {@condition Poisoned} condition. Whenever you eat food as part of a {@rule Short Rest} and spend one or more Hit Dice to regain {@rule Hit Points}, you regain additional {@rule Hit Points} equal to your Constitution modifier + your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}. In addition, as a {@rule Bonus Action} you can eat a morsel of food to regain {@rule Hit Points} equal to {@dice 1d8} + your Constitution modifier + your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}; once you use this {@rule Bonus Action}, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Add Poison Resistance, Advantage vs forced movement/Prone, and a Short-Rest Bonus Action hearty snack heal so Vigor of Hills matches the other Primeval feats.

name: Divinely Favored
changeNote: Make available as an origin feat.
entries: A god chose you to carry a spark of their power.

You learn one cantrip of your choice from the Cleric spell list and one level 1 spell based on the divine ethos you choose from the Divine Ethos Spells table below. You also always have the {@spell Augury} spell prepared.

You can cast the chosen 1st-level spell and the {@spell Augury} spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast either of these spells in this way again. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).
In addition, you can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus for any spell you cast that uses the spellcasting ability you choose when you select this feat.

name: Initiate of the Order
changeNote: Make available as an origin feat, reflavor, and limit free casting to one spell per Long Rest to stay on par with {@feat magic initiate}
entries: You've received training from magic-users affiliated with an Order of Mages.

Choose one of the four orders to influence your magic: the Grey Mages, Black Mages, Red Mages, or White Mages. You learn one cantrip of your choice from the Wizard spell list and always have two level 1 spells prepared from the Order Spells table for your chosen order.

entries.caption: Order Spells
rows: Choose two from {@spell prismatic flash}, {@spell disguise self}, {@spell fog cloud}, and {@spell dissonant whispers}
Choose two from {@spell cause fear}, {@spell hex}, {@spell ray of sickness}, and {@spell false life}
Choose two from {@spell chromatic orb}, {@spell faerie fire}, {@spell feather fall}, and {@spell entangle}
Choose two from {@spell cure wounds}, {@spell detect magic}, {@spell mage armor}, and {@spell shield}

entries: You can cast one of the chosen level 1 spells without a spell slot, and you must finish a {@rule Long Rest} before you can cast a spell in this way again. You can also cast both spells using any spell slots you have.
Your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).

name: Squire of the Order
changeNote: Make available as an origin feat, reflavor
entries: Your training in the ways of a martial knightly order grants you these benefits:

entries.name: Mount Up
entries: Mounting or dismounting costs you only 5 feet of movement.

entries.name: Precise Strike
entries: Once per turn, when you make a weapon attack roll against a creature, you can cause the attack roll to have {@rule Advantage}. If the attack hits, you roll {@damage 1d8} and add the number rolled as a bonus to the attack's damage roll. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, but a use is expended only if the attack hits. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Revenant Blade
entries: You learned from a master of the {@item double-bladed scimitar}, and some of that mastery has passed on to you. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Whirling Defense
entries: While you are holding a {@item double-bladed scimitar} with two hands, you gain a +1 bonus to {@rule Armor Class}.

entries.name: Finesse Mastery
entries: A {@item double-bladed scimitar} has the Finesse property when you wield it.

name: Novice of the Dragon Cult
changeNote: Allow Bonus Action fear a few times per day.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dragon's Tongue
entries: You know Draconic. If you already know Draconic when you select this feat, you instead learn one language of your choice.

entries.name: Dragon's Terror
entries: You can take a {@action Magic} action to instill terror in a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier and {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}; choose the ability when you select this feat) or have the {@condition Frightened} condition until the end of your next turn. If the target succeeds on the save or when the effect ends for a target, the target is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

You can use this benefit as a {@rule Bonus Action} instead of a {@action Magic} action a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Inspired by Fear
entries: When you cause a creature to have the {@condition Frightened} condition and you are the source of its fear, you can gain {@rule Heroic Inspiration} if you lack it. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Novice of the Emerald Enclave
changeNote: Add a skill proficiency and allow BOnus Action help a few times per day.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Speak with Animals
entries: You always have the {@spell Speak with Nature} spell prepared and can cast it with any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). When you cast this spell as a {@rule Ritual}, its duration is 8 hours.

entries.name: Forest's Lore
entries: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Nature}, or {@skill Survival}.

entries.name: Tag Team
entries: When you take the {@action Help} action, you can switch places with a willing ally within 5 feet of yourself as part of that same action. This movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|Opportunity Attacks}. You can't use this benefit if the ally has the {@condition Incapacitated} condition.

You can use this benefit as a {@rule Bonus Action} instead of a {@action Help} action a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Novice of the Songbirds
changeNote: Add a skill proficiency and allow Bonus Action help a few times per day.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Thieves' Cant
entries: You know Thieves' Cant.

entries.name: Instrument Training
entries: You gain proficiency with a {@item Musical Instrument} of your choice and in one of the following skills: {@skill Insight}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Sleight of Hand}.

entries.name: Distracting Melody
entries: When you take the {@action Help} action to assist an ally's attack roll, the enemy you're distracting can be within 30 feet of you, rather than within 5 feet of you, provided the enemy can see or hear you.

You can take this {@action Help} action as a {@rule Bonus Action} a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Novice of the Lord's Alliance
changeNote: Allow Inspiring Strike on crit and on reducing an enemy to 0 so that it trigger more than never per session.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Inspiring Strike
entries: Once per turn when you score a {@rule Critical Hit} against a creature or reduce an enemy to 0 {@rule Hit Points}, you can choose an ally within 30 feet of yourself who can see or hear you and who lacks {@rule Heroic Inspiration}. That ally gains {@rule Heroic Inspiration}. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Reassert Honor
entries: When an enemy you can see deals damage to an ally of yours that is within 5 feet of you, you have {@rule Advantage} on your next attack roll against that enemy before the end of your next turn.

name: Novice of the Lionsguard
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Entreat
entries: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Insight}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Persuasion}.

entries.name: Rallying Cry
entries: When you roll {@rule Initiative} and don't have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} that you can see within 30 feet of yourself. Those creatures gain {@rule Heroic Inspiration} and a number of {@rule Temporary Hit Points} equal to twice your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}.
Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Add Temporary Hit Points on Rallying Cry so it stands out from Musician as a combat-opener feat.

name: Novice of Spellfire
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Magic Absorption
entries: Once per turn, when you take damage from a spell or magical effect, you reduce the total damage taken by {@dice 1d4}. You can't use this benefit if you have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition.

entries.name: Spellfire Flame
entries: You learn the {@spell Sacred Flame} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can also cast this cantrip as a {@rule Bonus Action} a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Novice of the Pale Guard
changeNote: Small buffs to existing features plus a new way to do a few reaction attacks per day. This one was dull.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Stand as One
entries: When an ally within 5 feet of you is subjected to an effect that would push or pull it or give it the {@condition Prone} condition, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to prevent that ally from being moved or knocked {@condition Prone}. To receive this benefit, the ally can't have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition.

entries.name: Hold the Line
entries: When an enemy within 5 feet of you hits an ally of yours with an attack roll, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to make one melee attack against that enemy. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Vigilant
entries: When you take the {@action Ready} action, attack rolls against you have {@rule Disadvantage} until you take your readied response or until the start of your next turn, whichever comes first.

name: Novice of the Court of Owls
changeNote: Give one free use of Family First then require spending Inspiration, also give advantage on Opportunity Attacks.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Exploit Opening
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on attack rolls for {@action Opportunity Attack|Opportunity Attacks}. When you roll damage for an {@action Opportunity Attack}, you can roll the damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

entries.name: Family First
entries: When you roll {@rule Initiative}, you can give yourself and your allies within 30 feet of you {@rule Advantage} on that {@rule Initiative} roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, unless you expend {@rule Heroic Inspiration} to use it again.

name: Adept of the Dragon Cult
changeNote: Allow use as part of attack and give disadvantage to enemies you're hitting.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Damage Resistance
entries: When you gain this feat, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. You have {@rule Resistance} to the chosen damage type.

entries.name: Fearsome Power
entries: When you deal damage to a creature as part of the {@action Attack} or {@action Magic} action on your turn, you can use the Dragon's Terror benefit of the Novice of the Dragon Cult feat as part of that attack. If you target the creature you damaged, it has {@rule Disadvantage} on the saving throw.

name: Adept of the Enclave
changeNote: Totally reworked as a beastmaster / shapeshifter  summoner feat.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Friend to Animals
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on ability checks when taking the {@action Influence} action with Beasts.

entries.name: Kindred Ferocity
entries: Once per turn, when a Beast ally you can see within 30 feet of yourself hits a creature with an attack roll, that Beast deals extra damage to the target equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}. This benefit also applies to you while you are in a Beast form, such as from Wild Shape or Polymorph.

entries.name: Two Hearts, One Mind
entries: You always have the {@spell Beast Ally} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Adept Songbird
changeNote: Small buff to trigger Inspiring Willpower when you avoid OR end a bad condition.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Withering Wordplay
entries: When you take the {@action Help} action to assist an ally's attack roll against an enemy, that enemy also has {@rule Disadvantage} on the first saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Inspiring Willpower
entries: If you succeed on a saving throw to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed}, {@condition Frightened}, {@condition Paralyzed}, or {@condition Stunned} condition on yourself, you can choose one ally you can see within 30 feet of yourself that has the same condition. That condition immediately ends for that ally.

name: Adept of the Lord's Alliance
changeNote: This one was bad. Now recharges on rests for the 'stand up' command and has a small improvement on Reassert Honor in the prereq.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Standard Bearer
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, choose up to three creatures within 60 feet of yourself that can see you. Each target can immediately take a {@rule Reaction} to right itself and end the {@condition Prone} condition, provided its {@rule Speed} isn't 0. Additionally, you bolster the targets' resolve, which lasts for 1 minute or until you have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition. While bolstered, a target can't be possessed or gain the {@condition Charmed} or {@condition Frightened} condition; if a target is already possessed, {@condition Charmed}, or {@condition Frightened}, the target has {@rule Advantage} on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.
Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Honor Avenged
entries: The Reassert Honor benefit of the {@feat Novice of the Lord's Alliance} feat now triggers when an enemy you can see deals damage to an ally of yours within 30 feet of you, rather than within 5 feet of you. In addition, once per turn when you hit an enemy with an attack roll that had {@rule Advantage} from Reassert Honor, the attack deals extra damage equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}.

name: Adept of the Pale Guard
changeNote: Give Stronger Together benefit to STR and CON saves and a new benefit to enable a readied action fighter build.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Resurge
entries: When you have the {@condition Prone} condition, you can right yourself with only 5 feet of movement.

entries.name: Stronger Together
entries: If you are within 5 feet of an ally that doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition, you and that ally have {@rule Advantage} on Strength and Constitution saving throws. You can't use this benefit while you have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition.

entries.name: Steadfast
entries: When you take the {@action Ready} action and choose the {@action Attack} action as your readied response, you can make every attack that action would normally allow (such as from Extra Attack) when the trigger occurs. Taking that readied action doesn't expend your {@rule Reaction}.

name: Adept of the Lionguard
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Encourage Ally
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you bolster one ally you can see within 30 feet. The ally gains {@rule Temporary Hit Points} equal to {@dice 2d6} plus the modifier of the ability score increased by this feat. You can take this {@rule Bonus Action} a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Last Stand
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on attack rolls while {@status Bloodied}.

name: Adept of Spellfire
changeNote: Add a way to get back your spent hit dice if you can manage to get hit by more spells.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fueled Spellfire
entries: Once per turn, when a spell you cast deals Radiant damage, you can expend up to two {@rule Hit Point Dice}, roll them, and add the total rolled to one damage roll of the spell.

entries.name: Spellfire Reservoir
entries: When you reduce damage with the Magic Absorption benefit of the Novice of Spellfire feat, you regain one expended {@rule Hit Point Dice|Hit Point Die}.

entries.name: Searing Spellfire
entries: When you make a damage roll that deals Radiant damage, it ignores {@rule Resistance} to Radiant damage.

name: Adept of the Court

feat: novice of the court of owls

entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Retaliate
entries: Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can make an {@action Opportunity Attack} against that creature.

entries.name: Versatile Merc
entries: When you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, choose a skill in which you have proficiency. You have {@rule Expertise} in that skill until you finish your next {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Genie Magic
changeNote: Recharge Wish Magic on a Short or Long Rest and add the Elementalism cantrip so it competes with Fey-Touched and Shadow-Touched.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Elemental Spark
entries: You learn the {@spell Elementalism} cantrip. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Wish Magic
entries: As a {@action Magic} action, you can cast a level 1 spell of your choice from the Sorcerer spell list that has a casting time of an action. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.
When you reach level 11, the spell you cast with this feat is cast as though using a level 2 spell slot.
When you reach level 17, the spell is cast as though using a level 3 spell slot.

name: Street Justice
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Headlock
entries: Your allies have {@rule Advantage} on attack rolls against a creature {@condition Grappled} by you.

entries.name: Sturdy Knot
entries: When you use {@item Chain}, {@item Manacles}, or {@item Rope} to bind a creature, add your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} to the DC to escape or burst the {@item Chain}, {@item Manacles}, or {@item Rope}.

entries.name: Tough Talk
entries: A creature's {@rule Hostile [Attitude]|Hostile} attitude doesn't impose {@rule Disadvantage} on your Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks to influence that creature.

name: Gift of the Chromatic Dragon
changeNote: Make available as an origin feat.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Chromatic Infusion
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you can touch a Simple or Martial weapon and infuse it with one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. For 1 minute, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d4} damage of the chosen type when it hits. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Reactive Resistance
entries: When you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison damage, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to give yourself {@rule Resistance} to that instance of damage. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Gift of the Gem Dragon
changeNote: Make available as an origin feat.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Telekinetic Reprisal
entries: When you take damage from a creature within 10 feet of yourself, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to emanate telekinetic energy. The creature that dealt the damage must make a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier and {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}; choose the ability when you select this feat). On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 2d8} Force damage and is pushed up to 10 feet straight away from you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Gift of the Metallic Dragon
changeNote: Make available as an origin feat.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Draconic Healing
entries: You always have the {@spell Cure Wounds} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Protective Wings
entries: When you or another creature you can see within 5 feet of yourself is hit by an attack roll, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to manifest spectral wings from your back for a moment. The target gains a bonus to its AC equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} against that attack roll, potentially causing it to miss. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Hexer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hex
entries: You always have the {@spell Hex} spell prepared. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

entries.name: Curse Magic
entries: When a creature that you've cursed with {@spell Hex} hits you with an attack roll, the creature takes Psychic damage equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}. A creature takes this damage only once per turn.

name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. This feat can't increase an ability score above 20.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Alert
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Initiative Proficiency
entries: When you roll {@rule Initiative}, you can add your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} to the roll.

entries.name: Initiative Swap
entries: Immediately after you roll {@rule Initiative}, you can swap your {@rule Initiative} with the {@rule Initiative} of one willing ally in the same combat. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the {@condition Incapacitated} condition.

name: Charger
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Dash
entries: When you take the {@action Dash} action, your {@rule Speed} increases by 10 feet for that action.

entries.name: Charge Attack
entries: If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a target immediately before hitting it with a melee attack roll as part of the {@action Attack} action, choose one of the following effects: gain a {@damage 1d8} bonus to the attack's damage roll, or push the target up to 10 feet away if it is no more than one size larger than you. You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns.

name: Crossbow Expert
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ignore Loading
entries: You ignore the Loading property of the {@item Hand Crossbow}, {@item Heavy Crossbow}, and {@item Light Crossbow} (all called crossbows elsewhere in this feat). If you're holding one of them, you can load a piece of ammunition into it even if you lack a free hand.

entries.name: Firing in Melee
entries: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose {@rule Disadvantage} on your attack rolls with crossbows.

entries.name: Dual Wielding
entries: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the extra attack if that attack is with a crossbow that has the Light property and you aren't already adding that modifier to the damage.

name: Defensive Duelist
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Parry
entries: If you're holding a Finesse weapon and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to add your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} to your {@rule Armor Class}, potentially causing the attack to miss you. You gain this bonus to your AC against melee attacks until the start of your next turn.

name: Dual Wielder
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Enhanced Dual Wielding
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn and attack with a weapon that has the Light property, you can make one extra attack as a {@rule Bonus Action} later on the same turn with a different weapon, which must be a Melee weapon that lacks the Two-Handed property. You don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative.

entries.name: Quick Draw
entries: You can draw or stow two weapons that lack the Two-Handed property when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

name: Fey-Touched
entries: Your exposure to the Feywild's magic grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Fey Magic
entries: Choose one level 1 spell from the Divination or Enchantment school of magic. You always have that spell and the {@spell Misty Step} spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Grappler
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Punch and Grab
entries: When you hit a creature with an {@rule Unarmed Strike} as part of the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can use both the Damage and the Grapple option. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

entries.name: Attack Advantage
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on attack rolls against a creature {@condition Grappled} by you.

entries.name: Fast Wrestler
entries: You don't have to spend extra movement to move a creature {@condition Grappled} by you if the creature is your size or smaller.

name: Great Weapon Master
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Heavy Weapon Mastery
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon that has the Heavy property as part of the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can cause the weapon to deal extra damage to the target. The extra damage equals your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Hew
entries: Immediately after you score a {@rule Critical Hit} with a Melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 {@rule Hit Points} with one, you can make one attack with the same weapon as a {@rule Bonus Action}.

name: Healer
changeNote: Allow one free Battle Medic heal per rest without expending the target's Hit Die, and also reroll 2s on healing dice.
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Battle Medic
entries: If you have a {@item Healer's Kit}, you can expend one use of it and tend to a creature within 5 feet of yourself as a {@action Utilize} action. That creature can expend one of its {@rule Hit Point Dice}, and you then roll that die. The creature regains a number of {@rule Hit Points} equal to the roll plus your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}. Once per {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}, you can use this benefit without the creature expending a Hit Point Die (rolling a die of the creature's Hit Point Die size).

entries.name: Healing Rerolls
entries: Whenever you roll a die to determine the number of {@rule Hit Points} you restore with a spell or with this feat's Battle Medic benefit, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1 or 2, and you must use the new roll.

name: Heavily Armored
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Armor Training
entries: You gain training with Heavy armor. While wearing Heavy armor, you ignore any Strength requirement of the armor.

changeNote: Ignore Heavy armor Strength requirements. Keep an eye on this one,

name: Heavy Armor Master
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Damage Reduction
entries: When you're hit by an attack while you're wearing Heavy armor, any Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage dealt to you by that attack is reduced by an amount equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}.

name: Inspiring Leader
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bolstering Performance
entries: When you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}, you can give an inspiring performance: a speech, song, or dance. When you do so, choose up to six allies (which can include yourself) within 30 feet of yourself who witness the performance. The chosen creatures each gain {@rule Temporary Hit Points} equal to your character level plus the modifier of the ability you increased with this feat.

name: Keen Mind
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Lore Knowledge
entries: Choose one of the following skills: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}, {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Nature}, or {@skill Religion}. If you lack proficiency in the chosen skill, you gain proficiency in it, and if you already have proficiency in it, you gain {@rule Expertise} in it.

entries.name: Quick Study
entries: You can take the {@action Study} action as a {@rule Bonus Action}. When you successfully use this {@action Study} action to analyze a creature you can see (DC 10 plus half its Challenge Rating, rounded down), you learn one Damage Resistance, Vulnerability, or Immunity it has (or its lowest saving throw modifier), and you can choose to either gain {@rule Advantage} on your next attack roll against it or impose {@rule Disadvantage} on the next saving throw it makes against your spells or features before the end of your next turn. You can gain this combat benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Give Quick Study a concrete combat payoff to differentiate all the {@feat Skill Expert} variants.

name: Lucky
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Luck Points
entries: You have a number of Luck Points equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} and can spend the points on the benefits below. You regain your expended Luck Points when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Advantage
entries: When you roll a {@dice d20} for a {@rule D20 Test}, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself {@rule Advantage} on the roll.

entries.name: Disadvantage
entries: When a creature rolls a {@dice d20} for an attack roll against you, you can spend 1 Luck Point to impose {@rule Disadvantage} on that roll.

name: Mage Slayer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Concentration Breaker
entries: When you damage a creature that is {@status Concentration|Concentrating}, it has {@rule Disadvantage} on the saving throw it makes to maintain {@status Concentration}.

entries.name: Guarded Mind
entries: If you fail an Intelligence, a Wisdom, or a Charisma saving throw, you can cause yourself to succeed instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Magic Initiate
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Two Cantrips
entries: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Level 1 Spell
entries: Choose a level 1 spell from the same list you selected for this feat's cantrips. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

entries.name: Spell Change
entries: Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose for this feat with a different spell of the same level from the chosen spell list.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different spell list each time.

name: Musician
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Instrument Training
entries: You gain proficiency with three Musical Instruments of your choice.

entries.name: Encouraging Song
entries: As you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, you can play a song on a {@item Musical Instrument} with which you have proficiency and give {@rule Heroic Inspiration} to a number of allies who hear the song equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}. When you finish a {@rule Short Rest}, you can play a brief tune to give {@rule Heroic Inspiration} to one ally who hears you and lacks it.

changeNote: Keep PB allies gaining Heroic Inspiration on a Long Rest, but limit Short Rest to one ally so it doesn't dwarf other origin feats.

name: Polearm Master
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Pole Strike
entries: Immediately after you take the {@action Attack} action and attack with a {@item Quarterstaff}, a {@item Spear}, or a weapon that has the Heavy and Reach properties, you can use a {@rule Bonus Action} to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon. The weapon deals Bludgeoning damage, and the weapon's damage die for this attack is a {@damage d4}.

entries.name: Reactive Strike
entries: While you're holding a {@item Quarterstaff}, a {@item Spear}, or a weapon that has the Heavy and Reach properties, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to make one melee attack against a creature that enters the reach you have with that weapon.

name: Resilient

choose.entry: Choose one ability in which you lack saving throw proficiency. Increase the chosen ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Saving Throw Proficiency
entries: You gain saving throw proficiency with the chosen ability.

name: Ritual Caster
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ritual Spells
entries: Choose a number of level 1 spells equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} that have the {@rule Ritual} tag. You always have those spells prepared, and you can cast them as Rituals or with any spell slots you have. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat. Whenever your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} increases thereafter, you can add an additional spell with the {@rule Ritual} tag of a level up to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} minus 1, and whenever you gain a level you can replace one spell chosen for this feat with another eligible {@rule Ritual} spell.

entries.name: Quick Ritual
entries: With this benefit, you can cast a {@rule Ritual} spell that you have prepared using its regular casting time rather than the extended time for a {@rule Ritual}. Doing so doesn't require a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't use this benefit again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Allow learning higher-level Ritual spells (up to PB - 1) as you level up and swapping one ritual on level-up.

name: Sentinel
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Guardian
entries: Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you takes the {@action Disengage} action or hits a target other than you with an attack, you can make an {@action Opportunity Attack} against that creature.

entries.name: Halt
entries: When you hit a creature with an {@action Opportunity Attack}, the creature's {@rule Speed} becomes 0 for the rest of the current turn.

name: Shadow-Touched
entries: Your exposure to the Shadowfell's magic grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Shadow Magic
entries: Choose one level 1 spell from the Illusion or Necromancy school of magic. You always have that spell and the {@spell Invisibility} spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Skilled
entries: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Skulker
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Blindsight
entries: You have {@sense Blindsight} with a range of 10 feet.

entries.name: Fog of War
entries: You exploit the distractions of battle, gaining {@rule Advantage} on any Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check you make as part of the {@action Hide} action during combat.

entries.name: Sniper
entries: If you make an attack roll while hidden and the roll misses, making the attack roll doesn't reveal your location.

name: Speedy
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Speed Increase
entries: Your {@rule Speed} increases by 10 feet.

entries.name: Dash over Difficult Terrain
entries: When you take the {@action Dash} action on your turn, {@rule Difficult Terrain} doesn't cost you extra movement for the rest of that turn.

entries.name: Agile Movement
entries: {@action Opportunity Attack|Opportunity Attacks} have {@rule Disadvantage} against you.

name: Spell Sniper
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bypass Cover
entries: Your attack rolls for spells ignore {@rule Cover|Half Cover} and {@rule Cover|Three-Quarters Cover}.

entries.name: Casting in Melee
entries: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose {@rule Disadvantage} on your attack rolls with spells.

entries.name: Increased Range
entries: When you cast a spell that has a range of at least 10 feet and requires you to make an attack roll, you can increase the spell's range by 60 feet.

entries.name: Arcane Precision
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature that is at least 30 feet away from you with a spell's attack roll, you can add your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} to the damage roll.

changeNote: Add Arcane Precision so the feat also does something in smaller areas.

name: Telekinetic
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Minor Telekinesis
entries: You learn the {@spell Mage Hand} spell. You can cast it without Verbal or Somatic components, you can make the spectral hand {@condition Invisible}, and its range and the distance it can be away from you both increase by 30 feet when you cast it. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Telekinetic Shove
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you can telekinetically shove one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. When you do so, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw ({@dc 8} plus the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat and your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}) or be moved 5 feet toward or away from you.

name: Tough
entries: Your {@rule Hit Points|Hit Point} maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a character level thereafter, your {@rule Hit Points|Hit Point} maximum increases by an additional 2 {@rule Hit Points}.

name: War Caster
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Concentration
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain {@status Concentration}.

entries.name: Reactive Spell
entries: When a hostile creature provokes an {@action Opportunity Attack} from you by leaving your reach, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to cast a spell at the creature rather than making an {@action Opportunity Attack}. The spell must have a casting time of one action and must target only that creature.

entries.name: Somatic Components
entries: You can perform the Somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a {@item Shield} in one or both hands.

name: Weapon Master
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Mastery Properties
entries: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of Simple or Martial weapons of your choice, provided you have proficiency with them. Whenever you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, you can change those choices to other eligible weapons.

entries.name: Tactical Versatility
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, you can replace that weapon's mastery property with the Push, Sap, or Slow property for that attack.

changeNote: Grant two Weapon Masteries and allow switching around once per turn for some tactical versatility compared to other feats.

name: Agent of Order
entries: You can channel cosmic forces of order to gain these benefits:

entries.name: Stasis Strike
entries: Once per turn, when you damage a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d8} force damage to the target, and it must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the spellcasting ability you chose for the Scion of the Outer Planes feat) as spectral bindings try to ensnare it. On a successful save, the target escapes. On a failed save, the target has the restrained condition until the start of your next turn. These bindings manifest as chains or some other symbol of stasis. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Baleful Scion
entries: You can channel cosmic forces of evil to gain these benefits:

entries.name: Grasp of Avarice
