entries: Once per turn, when you damage a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself, you can also deal necrotic damage to it. The necrotic damage equals {@damage 1d6} + your proficiency bonus, and you regain a number of hit points equal to this necrotic damage dealt. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Cohort of Chaos
changeNote: Allow triggering Chaotic Flare intentionally as a Bonus Action PB/LR and limit effects to enemies only so you aren't griefing.
entries: You can channel cosmic forces of chaos to gain these benefits:

entries.name: Chaotic Flare
entries: When you roll a 1 or a 20 on an attack roll or a saving throw, the magic of chaos flows through you. You can also trigger this magic intentionally as a {@rule Bonus Action} a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. Roll a d4 and consult the Chaotic Flares table to determine what happens. A flare lasts until the end of your next turn, and a new flare can't occur until after the first flare ends.

entries.caption: Chaotic Flares
rows: {@b Battle Fury.} A creature of your choice that you can see is filled with reckless fury. It has advantage on attack rolls and disadvantage on ability checks.

{@b Disruption Field.} Waves of energy ripple around you. Each creature of your choice that starts its turn within 5 feet of you, or that moves into that area for the first time on a turn, takes {@damage 1d8} Force damage.

{@b Unbound.} When you move, you can use some or all of your walking speed to teleport yourself once, along with any equipment you're wearing or carrying, up to the distance used to an unoccupied space that you can see.
{@b Wailing Winds.} Winds swirl in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on you. Creatures of your choice in that area have {@rule Disadvantage} on Wisdom saving throws.

name: Outlands Envoy
entries: You have spent significant time in Sigil or the Outlands, the crossroads of the multiverse. Being steeped in converging planar energies grants you these benefits:

entries.name: Crossroads Emissary
entries: You learn the {@spell misty step} and {@spell tongues} spells. You can cast each spell once using this feat without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast that spell in this way again. When you cast {@spell tongues} using this feat, you require no material components. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the one chosen when you gained the Scion of the Outer Planes feat.

name: Planar Wanderer
entries: You can draw on the forces of the multiverse to survive cosmic extremes and to traverse its infinite realms, granting you these benefits:

entries.name: Planar Adaptation
entries: When you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. You have {@rule Resistance} to the chosen damage type until you finish your next {@rule Long Rest}. Once per {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}, you can change this chosen damage type as a {@rule Bonus Action}.

entries.name: Planar Jaunt
entries: You always have the {@spell Blink} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

entries.name: Portal Mastery
entries: You know the direction to the last planar portal you used while you and the portal are on the same plane of existence, and as an action you can detect the location of any portals within 30 feet of you that aren't behind {@rule Cover|Total Cover} (once per {@rule Long Rest}). Additionally, as an action, you can concentrate on a portal within 5 feet of you and make a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check to force it open or closed for 1 hour without a portal key; on a failure, you take {@damage 3d8} Psychic damage and can't try again on that portal until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Add +1 any ASI, broaden Planar Adaptation, and add Blink 1/LR so the feat is useable even when you aren't portal-hopping.

name: Righteous Heritor
entries: You can channel cosmic forces of good to gain these benefits:

entries.name: Soothe Pain
entries: When you or a creature within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to reduce that damage by {@dice 1d10} + your proficiency bonus. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Scion of the Outer Planes
changeNote: Make available as an origin feat and add a tiny combat effect plus a language.
entries: Your connection to an Outer Plane infuses you with its energy, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Planar Infusion
entries: Choose a type of plane from the Planar Infusion table. You gain {@rule Resistance} to the listed damage type, learn the listed cantrip (which you can cast without Material components), and learn the listed language. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the cantrip (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Planar Attunement
entries: When you roll {@rule Initiative}, you can channel planar energy through yourself. You gain {@rule Temporary Hit Points} equal to {@dice 1d6} plus your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and once before the end of your next turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can deal that much extra damage of the type to which this feat grants you Resistance. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Collegiate Initiate
entries: You have studied magical theory within a formal arcane academy or scholarly tradition, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Academic Discipline
entries: Choose one of the five scholarly disciplines from the Collegiate Spells table: Lore, Expression, Geometry, Rhetoric, or Alchemy. You learn one cantrip, always have one level 1 spell prepared, and gain proficiency in one skill as specified for your chosen discipline.

You can cast the chosen level 1 spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat). Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace the cantrip or level 1 spell with another eligible choice from your discipline's row.

entries.caption: Collegiate Spells
rows: {@spell Fire Bolt}, {@spell Prestidigitation}, or {@spell Ray of Frost}
{@spell Sacred Flame}, {@spell Thaumaturgy}, or {@spell Vicious Mockery}
{@spell Chill Touch}, {@spell Druidcraft}, or {@spell Spare the Dying}

changeNote: Make available as an origin feat; add a skill proficiency and first level spell as a sidegrade to Magic Initiate.

name: Collegiate Mascot
entries: You have learned how to summon an arcane mascot tied to your scholarly discipline, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Mascot Familiar
entries: You always have the {@spell Find Familiar} spell prepared and can cast it as a {@rule Ritual}. Your familiar can take the form of the mascot associated with the discipline you chose for the {@feat Collegiate Initiate} feat: a {@creature spirit statue mascot} (Lore), an {@creature art elemental mascot} (Expression), a {@creature fractal mascot} (Geometry), an {@creature inkling mascot} (Rhetoric), or a {@creature pest mascot} (Alchemy). Its {@rule Hit Points|Hit Point} maximum increases by an amount equal to your character level.

entries.name: Coordinated Strike
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can forgo one attack to allow your mascot familiar to make one attack of its own using its {@rule Reaction}.

entries.name: Transpose
entries: If your mascot familiar is within 60 feet of you, you can teleport as a {@rule Bonus Action}, swapping places with the familiar. If your destination space is too small for you to occupy, the teleportation fails and is wasted. Once you teleport in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, unless you expend a spell slot of level 2 or higher to do it again.

changeNote: Update to General standard, scale mascot HP by character level, and change swap teleport to a Bonus Action.

name: Artificer Initiate
changeNote: Make available as an origin feat, grant Advantage with the chosen Artisan's Tool, and let it serve as a universal focus.
entries: You've learned some of an artificer's inventiveness, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Artificer Magic
entries: You learn one cantrip and one level 1 spell of your choice from the Artificer spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat). You always have the level 1 spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have. Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of these spells with another eligible Artificer spell of the same level.

entries.name: Masterwork Focus
entries: You gain proficiency with one type of {@item Artisan's Tools} of your choice, you have {@rule Advantage} on ability checks you make using that tool, and you can use that tool as a spellcasting focus for any spell you cast.

name: Eldritch Adept
entries: Studying occult lore, you unlock eldritch power, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Eldritch Invocation
entries: You learn one Eldritch Invocation from the following options: Armor of Shadows, Devil's Sight, Eldritch Sight, Eyes of the Rune Keeper, Fiendish Vigor, Mask of Many Faces, Misty Visions, Nature's Speech, or Otherworldly Leap.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for any spell granted by the invocation (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Invocation Change
entries: Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace the invocation learned from this feat with another eligible invocation.

changeNote: Make available as an origin feat with a curated list of invocations for non-Warlocks.

name: Fighting Initiate
changeNote: Make available as an origin feat.
entries: Your martial training has helped you develop a particular style of fighting, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Fighting Style
entries: You learn one Fighting Style option of your choice from the Fighter class. If you already have a style, the one you choose must be different.

entries.name: Style Versatility
entries: Whenever you reach a level that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can replace this feat's Fighting Style with another one from the Fighter class that you don't have.

name: Gunner
entries: You have a quick hand and keen eye when employing firearms, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Firearm Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with firearms (see "{@rule Firearms}" in the Dungeon Master's Guide).

entries.name: Quick Reload
entries: You ignore the Loading property of firearms, and you can load a piece of ammunition into a firearm you're holding even if you lack a free hand.

entries.name: Point-Blank Shot
entries: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose {@rule Disadvantage} on your ranged attack rolls.

changeNote: Allow loading firearms without a free hand (matching {@feat Crossbow Expert}).

name: Metamagic Adept
entries: You've learned how to exert your will on your spells to alter how they function, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Metamagic Options
entries: You learn two Metamagic options of your choice from the Sorcerer class. You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it, unless the option says otherwise. Whenever you reach a level that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can replace one of these Metamagic options with another one from the Sorcerer class.

entries.name: Sorcery Points
entries: You gain 2 Sorcery Points to spend on Metamagic (these points are added to any Sorcery Points you have from another source, but can be used only on Metamagic). You regain all spent Sorcery Points when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Update to General feat standard (Level 4 prereq and +1 INT/WIS/CHA).

name: Arathi Heritage
entries: As a descendant of humans from Arathor and high elves from Quel'Thalas, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed} condition, and magic can't put you to sleep..

entries.name: Arathi Resolve
entries: When you fail a saving throw to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed}, {@condition Frightened}, or {@condition Unconscious} condition, you can choose to succeed instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Highborne Spark
entries: You learn one cantrip of your choice from the Wizard spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

changeNote: Broaden Lethargy Resilience to Charmed/Frightened/Unconscious once per Long Rest and add a Wizard cantrip to match other origin feat power.

name: Child of the Sea
entries: As a child of the sea, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ocean Born
entries: You have a {@rule Swim Speed} equal to your {@rule Speed}, you can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes, and being underwater doesn't impose {@rule Disadvantage} on your attack rolls.

entries.name: Tide's Resilience
entries: You have {@rule Resistance} to Cold damage.

entries.name: Sea Legs
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid being moved against your will or knocked {@condition Prone}.

changeNote: Add Cold Resistance, Sea Legs (Advantage vs forced movement/Prone), and underwater combat fluency so this isn't a ribbon feat.

name: Clearcasting
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Clearcasting
entries: When you score a {@rule Critical Hit} with a spell's attack roll, or when a creature rolls a 1 on a saving throw against a spell you cast, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to cast a cantrip with a casting time of an action. Additionally, once per {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}, when you cast a spell using a spell slot, you can immediately cast a cantrip with a casting time of an action as a {@rule Bonus Action}.

entries.name: Force Adept
entries: Spells you cast ignore {@rule Resistance} to Force damage, and when you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals Force damage, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3.

changeNote: Open ASI to all mental scores, trigger Reaction cantrip on enemy nat 1 saves, and add 1/SR Bonus Action cantrip after leveled spell, and buff Force Adept.

name: Elusive Brawler
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Reactive Dodge
entries: When you take damage, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to take the {@action Dodge} action.

name: Enveloping Mist
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Enveloping Mist
entries: When you cast a spell or use a feature to restore {@rule Hit Points} to a creature, the creature is wrapped in a healing mist. Roll one of the dice from the feature that healed it (or use your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1, if the healing doesn't roll dice), and note that number as the creature's Life Cocoon value.

If the creature is hit by an attack roll before the start of its next turn, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to reduce the damage it takes from that attack by its Life Cocoon value. The mist then disappears.
At the start of the creature's next turn, if the mist persists, the creature gains {@rule Temporary Hit Points} equal to its Life Cocoon value.

changeNote: Clarify Life Cocoon for healing features that don't roll dice.

name: Fingers of Frost
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cold Mastery
entries: Spells you cast ignore {@rule Resistance} to Cold damage.

entries.name: Frostbite
entries: Once per turn when you deal Cold damage to a creature that has the {@condition Grappled} or {@condition Restrained} condition, or whose {@rule Speed} is 0, the creature takes extra Cold damage. To determine the extra damage, roll a number of d4s equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} and add them together.

changeNote: Open ASI to mental scores, cap Frostbite to once per turn, and trigger it against Grappled, Restrained, or 0-Speed creatures so most ice spells work better.

name: Fists of Fury
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Clean Hits
entries: When you roll damage for an attack you make with an {@rule Unarmed Strike} or a weapon that has the Light property, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.

entries.name: Combo Strikes
entries: When you deal damage to a creature with an {@rule Unarmed Strike} or a weapon that has the Light property, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll for each time you previously hit that creature with a melee attack roll in the same turn.

changeNote: Increase Combo Strikes bonus to +2 per previous hit and apply it to Unarmed Strikes and Light weapons so multi-hit brawlers match GWM.

name: Hot Streak
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ignite
entries: Once per turn when a spell you cast deals Fire damage to a creature, the target starts burning (taking {@damage 1d4} Fire damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature uses an action to extinguish the flames). If the creature is already burning, the flames intensify, increasing the burning damage by {@damage 1d4} (to a maximum number of d4s equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}).

entries.name: Pyromaniac Streak
entries: Once per turn when you score a hit by 5 or more over a targets AC with a spell that deals Fire damage, or when a creature fails its saving throw against a Fire spell you cast by 5 or more, you deal an extra {@damage 1d8} Fire damage to that creature and gain {@rule Advantage} on your next spell attack roll before the end of your next turn.

changeNote: Open ASI to mental scores; replace Fire resistance piercing (that's {@feat Elemental Adept}) with a Hot Streak over-hit/crit-fail mechanic. Cap Ignite scaling to PB.

name: Inscription Adept
entries: Your mastery of inscription allows you to weave magic into ink and parchment, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Master Scribe
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item Calligrapher's Supplies} (or {@rule Expertise} if you already have proficiency). You craft {@item Spell Scroll|Spell Scrolls} in half the normal time and for 25 percent less gold.

entries.name: Inscribed Spells
entries: You always have the {@spell Illusory Script} and {@spell Comprehend Languages} spells prepared. You can cast each once without a spell slot or Material components, regaining the ability to do so when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, and you can also cast them using spell slots you have. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Quick Glyph
entries: Starting at level 5, you always have the {@spell Glyph of Warding} spell prepared and can cast it with spell slots you have. Additionally, once per {@rule Long Rest}, you can spend 1 minute to inscribe a temporary Explosive Runes glyph without expending a spell slot or Material components. The glyph lasts until you finish your next {@rule Long Rest} and deals {@damage 3d8} Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage on a failed Dexterity saving throw (half on a success), increasing to {@damage 5d8} at level 11 and {@damage 7d8} at level 17.

changeNote: Replace WoW crafting jargon with normal rules: Calligrapher's Supplies, faster/cheaper scrolls, Illusory Script, and a daily Quick Glyph.

name: Stagger and Sway
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Defer Damage
entries: When you take damage from an attack, you can reduce the damage you take by your Dexterity modifier (minimum of 1) and add a {@damage d6} to your Delayed Reaction pool. At the end of your turn, remove all dice from your Delayed Reaction pool and roll them; you take Force damage equal to the total rolled.

entries.name: Purify
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you can remove a number of dice up to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1) from your Delayed Reaction pool. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Make Defer Damage voluntary against attacks and cap Purify to PB/Long Rest to stop infinite damage negation edge case.

name: Survivor
entries: You draw on unyielding mortal determination to endure the worst, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Break Free
entries: At the start of your turn, if you have the {@condition Charmed}, {@condition Frightened}, {@condition Incapacitated}, {@condition Paralyzed}, or {@condition Stunned} condition (but not the {@condition Unconscious} condition), you can ignore the effects of those conditions until the end of your turn and immediately make a saving throw with {@rule Advantage} to end one of them if it allows a save. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}, unless you gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion} level to use it again.

entries.name: Gritty Resolve
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on {@rule Death Saving Throw|Death Saving Throws} and on saving throws against effects that would give you {@condition Exhaustion} levels. Additionally, when you become {@status Bloodied} or take damage while {@status Bloodied}, you can gain {@rule Temporary Hit Points} equal to your character level plus your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} (no action required). Once you gain these Temporary Hit Points, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Upgrade Break Free to 1/SR with an immediate Advantage repeat save, and add Gritty Resolve (1/SR automatic Temp HP when Bloodied) so it triggers reliably every combat.

name: Bountiful Luck
entries: Your people have extraordinary luck, which you have learned to mystically lend to your companions when you see them falter. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shared Fortune
entries: When an ally you can see within 30 feet of you rolls a 1 or 2 on the {@dice d20} for an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to let the ally reroll the die. The ally must use the new roll.

changeNote: Update to 2024 standard (+1 DEX/CON/CHA, Level 4), trigger on ally rolls of 1 or 2, and remove the penalty disabling your racial Lucky trait.

name: Dragon Fear
entries: When angered, you radiate menace, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Draconic Roar
entries: Instead of exhaling destructive energy, you can expend a use of your Breath Weapon trait to roar, forcing each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw ({@dc 8} + your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} + your Constitution or Charisma modifier). A target automatically succeeds on the save if it can't hear or see you. On a failed save, a target has the {@condition Frightened} condition for 1 minute. If the {@condition Frightened} target takes any damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

changeNote: Very minor. Allow CON or CHA for the save DC (matching current Dragonborn Breath Weapon).

name: Dragon Hide
entries: You manifest scales and claws reminiscent of your draconic ancestors, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Hardened Scales
entries: While you aren't wearing armor, you can calculate your AC as 13 + your Dexterity modifier (you can use a {@item Shield} and still gain this benefit), and any Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage you take from attacks is reduced by an amount equal to half your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} (rounded up).

entries.name: Elemental Claws
entries: You grow retractable claws from the tips of your fingers (no action to extend or retract). You can use your claws to make {@rule Unarmed Strike|Unarmed Strikes} that deal Slashing damage equal to {@damage 1d6} + your Strength or Dexterity modifier. Additionally, whenever you use your Breath Weapon trait, your claws are infused with elemental energy until the end of your next turn, dealing an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of your Breath Weapon's damage type on a hit.

changeNote: Add unarmored B/P/S damage reduction (half PB rounded up) and 1d6 Finesse claws that infuse with your Breath Weapon's element so that claws might actually see use.

name: Drow High Magic
entries: You learn more of the magic typical of dark elves, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Underdark Arcana
entries: You always have the {@spell Detect Magic}, {@spell Levitate}, and {@spell Dispel Magic} spells prepared. You can cast {@spell Detect Magic} at will without expending a spell slot. You can cast {@spell Levitate} and {@spell Dispel Magic} once each without expending a spell slot, regaining the ability to do so when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, and you can also cast them using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is the ability increased by this feat.

changeNote: Update to General standard.

name: Dwarven Fortitude
entries: You have the blood of dwarf heroes flowing through your veins, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Stalwart Defense
entries: You can take the {@action Dodge} action as a {@rule Bonus Action} a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. While you are benefiting from the {@action Dodge} action, you also have {@rule Advantage} on Strength and Constitution saving throws.

entries.name: Dwarven Recovery
entries: Whenever you take the {@action Dodge} action in combat, you can roll one of your {@rule Hit Point Dice}, add your Constitution modifier, and regain a number of {@rule Hit Points} equal to the total (minimum of 1). The first time you use this benefit after a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}, the Hit Point Die isn't expended; subsequent uses expend the rolled Hit Point Die.

changeNote: Add PB/LR Bonus Action Dodge, Advantage on STR/CON saves while Dodging, and a non-expended Hit Die on your first Dodge heal per Short or Long Rest.

name: Elven Accuracy
entries: The accuracy of elves is legendary, especially that of elf archers and spellcasters. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Precision Aim
entries: Whenever you have {@rule Advantage} on an attack roll using Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, you can reroll one of the dice once.

name: Fade Away
entries: Your people are clever, with a knack for illusion magic. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Illusory Escape
entries: Immediately after you take damage, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to magically gain the {@condition Invisible} condition until the end of your next turn (or until you attack, deal damage, or force someone to make a saving throw) and move up to 15 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|Opportunity Attacks}. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Scale Fade Away to PB/Long Rest, and include a 15-foot 'step'.

name: Fey Teleportation
entries: Your study of high elven lore has unlocked fey power that lets you stride briefly through the Feywild. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Sylvan Lore
entries: You learn to speak, read, and write {@language Sylvan}.

entries.name: Fey Step
entries: You always have the {@spell Misty Step} spell prepared and can cast it once without expending a spell slot, regaining the ability to do so when you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level, and your spellcasting ability for it is the ability increased by this feat. After you cast {@spell Misty Step}, you have {@rule Advantage} on the next attack roll you make before the end of your turn.

changeNote: Update to General standard, and grant Advantage on your next attack after Misty Step to differentiate from Fey-Touched.

name: Flames of Phlegethos
entries: You learn to call on hellfire to serve your commands, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Hellfire Mastery
entries: When you roll Fire damage for a spell you cast, you can reroll any roll of 1 or 2 on the Fire damage dice, and you must use the new roll.

entries.name: Wreath of Flame
entries: Whenever you cast a spell that deals Fire damage, you can cause flames to wreathe you until the end of your next turn, shedding Bright Light out to 30 feet and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. Once per turn when you wreathe yourself in these flames, you gain {@rule Temporary Hit Points} equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}. While the flames are present, any creature within 5 feet of you that hits you with a melee attack takes Fire damage equal to {@damage 1d4} + your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}.

changeNote: Reroll 1s and 2s on Fire spell damage, and upgrade the wreath ability to 1d4 + PB thorns plus PB Temp HP.

name: Infernal Constitution
entries: Fiendish blood runs strong in you, unlocking a resilience akin to that possessed by some fiends. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fiendish Resilience
entries: You have {@rule Resistance} to Cold and Poison damage, and you have {@rule Advantage} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned} condition. If you already have {@rule Resistance} to Cold or Poison damage from another source, you instead gain {@rule Resistance} to Acid or Lightning damage (your choice) for each duplicate resistance.

entries.name: Hellish Endurance
entries: When you fail a Constitution saving throw, you can reroll the save with {@rule Advantage}, and you must use the new result. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Allow swapping duplicate resistances to Acid or Lightning, and add Hellish Endurance (1/SR reroll CON save with Advantage).

name: Orcish Fury
entries: Your fury burns tirelessly, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Furious Strike
entries: Once per turn when you hit with an attack using a Simple or Martial weapon, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice an additional time, add it as extra damage of the weapon's type, and gain {@rule Temporary Hit Points} equal to the extra damage rolled. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Relentless Retaliation
entries: Immediately after you use your Relentless Endurance trait, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to make one weapon attack with {@rule Advantage}.

changeNote: Scale extra weapon damage die to PB/LR and give a little Temp HP, plus give Advantage on the Relentless Endurance reaction attack.

name: Prodigy
entries: You have a knack for quickly mastering new disciplines, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Broad Learning
entries: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice, proficiency with one tool of your choice, and fluency in one language of your choice.

entries.name: Tool Mastery
entries: Choose one tool in which you have proficiency; you gain {@rule Expertise} with that tool.

entries.name: Adaptable
entries: When you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, choose one skill or tool in which you lack proficiency. You gain proficiency with it until you finish your next {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Update to General standard and pivot from skill Expertise to floating proficiency so it doesn't strictly outclass Skill Expert.

name: Second Chance
entries: Fortune favors you when someone tries to strike you, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Lucky Sidestep
entries: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to force that creature to reroll. If the new roll misses, you can immediately move up to 10 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|Opportunity Attacks}. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll {@rule Initiative} at the start of combat or until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Add a 10-foot 'step' when the forced reroll misses.

name: Squat Nimbleness
entries: You are uncommonly nimble for your stature, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Nimble Stride
entries: Your {@rule Speed} increases by 5 feet.

entries.name: Skill Training
entries: You gain proficiency in {@skill Acrobatics} or {@skill Athletics} (your choice). If you already have proficiency in the chosen skill, you gain {@rule Expertise} in it.

entries.name: Slippery Target
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or escape the {@condition Grappled} or {@condition Restrained} condition. Additionally, you can move through the space of any creature that is at least one size larger than you without treating it as {@rule Difficult Terrain}, and {@action Opportunity Attack|Opportunity Attacks} made against you by creatures larger than you have {@rule Disadvantage}.

changeNote: Add Expertise if already proficient, add Advantage vs Restrained, and let you slip through larger enemy' spaces with Disadvantaged OAs.

name: Wood Elf Magic
entries: You learn the magic of the primeval woods, which are revered and protected by your people. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Primeval Magic
entries: You learn one Druid cantrip of your choice, and you always have the {@spell Longstrider} and {@spell Pass without Trace} spells prepared. You can cast {@spell Longstrider} and {@spell Pass without Trace} once each without expending a spell slot, regaining the ability to do so when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, and you can also cast them using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.

changeNote: Update to General standard.

name: Mist-Touched
entries: You were born in, lost to, or returned from the Mists, the realm between worlds where echoes of other realms and times linger. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Echo of Legends
entries: When you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, you can attune to an echo of a figure from the past. Choose one skill; you have proficiency in that skill until you finish your next {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Mist Shift
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you can slip briefly into the Mists and teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Actor
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Impersonation
entries: While you're disguised as a real or fictional person, you have {@rule Advantage} on Charisma ({@skill Deception} or {@skill Performance}) checks to convince others that you are that person.

entries.name: Mimicry
entries: You can mimic the sounds of other creatures, including speech. A creature that hears the mimicry must succeed on a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check to determine the effect is faked ({@dc 8} plus your Charisma modifier and {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}).

entries.name: Dramatic Distraction
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you can feint or create a convincing vocal distraction targeting one creature you can see within 30 feet that can see or hear you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Charisma modifier and {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}) or the next attack roll made against it by you or an ally before the start of your next turn has {@rule Advantage}. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Add a Bonus Action Dramatic Distraction feint so this feat does something in combat too.

name: Athlete
entries: You have undergone extensive physical training, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Athletic Training
entries: You gain proficiency in {@skill Acrobatics} or {@skill Athletics} (your choice).

entries.name: Climb Speed
entries: You gain a {@rule Climb Speed} equal to your {@rule Speed}.

entries.name: Hop Up
entries: When you have the {@condition Prone} condition, you can right yourself with only 5 feet of movement.

entries.name: Vault and Roll
entries: You can make a running {@rule Long Jump|Long} or {@rule High Jump} after moving only 5 feet, you can use either your Strength or Dexterity score to calculate your jump distances, and you have {@rule Resistance} to falling damage.

changeNote: Make available as an origin feat (remove ASI) and give some generic buffs.

name: Chef
entries: Time spent mastering the culinary arts has paid off, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Cook's Utensils
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item Cook's Utensils}. If you already have proficiency with them, you gain proficiency with another {@item Artisan's Tools} of your choice.

entries.name: Replenishing Meal
entries: As part of a {@rule Short Rest}, you can cook special food if you have ingredients and {@item Cook's Utensils} on hand. You can prepare enough of this food for a number of creatures equal to 4 plus your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}. At the end of the {@rule Short Rest}, any creature who eats the food and spends one or more Hit Dice to regain {@rule Hit Points} regains extra Hit Points equal to {@dice 1d8} plus your {@rule Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Bolstering Treats
entries: With 1 hour of work or when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, you can cook a number of hearty treats equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} if you have ingredients and {@item Cook's Utensils} on hand. These treats last until you finish your next {@rule Long Rest}. A creature can use a {@rule Bonus Action} to eat a treat or feed one to another creature within 5 feet, restoring {@rule Hit Points} equal to {@dice 1d4} plus your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}.

changeNote: Make available as an origin feat; Bolstering Treats restore HP instead of giving TempHP so they stay useable alongside Inspiring Leader.

name: Crafter
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with three different {@item Artisan's Tools} of your choice from the Fast Crafting table.

entries.name: Discount
entries: Whenever you buy a nonmagical item, you receive a 25 percent discount on it. In addition, the time and gold cost required for you to craft nonmagical items, potions, and scrolls are reduced by 25 percent.

entries.name: Fast Crafting
entries: When you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, you can craft one piece of gear from the Fast Crafting table (provided you have the associated {@item Artisan's Tools} and proficiency with them), plus one temporary consumable item of your choice from the following list: {@item Acid}, {@item Alchemist's Fire}, {@item Antitoxin}, {@item Basic Poison}, {@item Holy Water}, or {@item Oil}. These items last until you finish another {@rule Long Rest}, at which point they fall apart or lose potency.

entries.caption: Fast Crafting
rows: {@item Crossbow Bolt Case}, {@item Map or Scroll Case}, {@item Pouch}
{@item Ball Bearings}, {@item Bucket}, {@item Caltrops}, {@item Grappling Hook}, {@item Iron Pot}

entries.name: Improvised Expertise
entries: Whenever a nonmagical piece of adventuring gear you use or craft (such as {@item Ball Bearings}, {@item Caltrops}, a {@item Net}, {@item Acid}, or {@item Alchemist's Fire}) forces a creature to make a saving throw, you can replace the item's saving throw DC with {@dc 8} plus your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} plus your Dexterity or Intelligence modifier.

changeNote: Increade discount, reduce crafting time/cost, add a daily consumable, and scale mundane item save DCs so that they don't fall off entirely with level.

name: Crusher
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Push
entries: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Bludgeoning damage, you can move it 5 feet to an unoccupied space if the target is no more than one size larger than you.

entries.name: Enhanced Critical
entries: When you score a {@rule Critical Hit} that deals Bludgeoning damage to a creature, attack rolls against that creature have {@rule Advantage} until the start of your next turn.

name: Durable
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Defy Death
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on {@rule Death Saving Throw|Death Saving Throws} and on saving throws against effects that would give you {@condition Exhaustion} levels.

entries.name: Speedy Recovery
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you can roll one of your {@rule Hit Point Dice} and regain a number of {@rule Hit Points} equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1). The first time you use this benefit after a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}, the Hit Point Die isn't expended; subsequent uses expend the rolled Hit Point Die.

changeNote: Add CON mod to Speedy Recovery healing, make the first use per Short or Long Rest free, and add Advantage vs Exhaustion.

name: Elemental Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Energy Mastery
entries: Choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. Spells you cast ignore {@rule Resistance} to damage of the chosen type. In addition, when you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2, and once per turn you can add your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} to one damage roll of that type.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different damage type each time for Energy Mastery.

changeNote: Add +PB damage once per turn on the chosen damage type to make this a little more viable.

name: Lightly Armored
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Armor Training
entries: You gain training with Light armor and {@item Shield|Shields}, and you can use a {@item Shield} you are holding as a spellcasting focus for your spells.

changeNote: Allow using a Shield as a spellcasting focus so single-class casters might want this feat.

name: Martial Weapon Training
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Weapon Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons.

entries.name: Martial Mastery
entries: You can use the mastery property of one kind of Martial weapon of your choice. Whenever you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, you can change the kind of weapon to another Martial weapon.

changeNote: Grant one Martial weapon Mastery property alongside Martial weapon proficiency so non-martial builds can step into weapon combat.

name: Medium Armor Master
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dexterous Wearer
entries: While you're wearing Medium armor, you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC if you have a Dexterity score of 16 or higher, and wearing Medium armor doesn't impose {@rule Disadvantage} on your Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

entries.name: Glancing Blow
entries: Once per round when you are hit by an attack roll while wearing Medium armor, you can reduce the damage dealt to you by that attack by an amount equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum of 1).

changeNote: Restore no Stealth Disadvantage alongside the +3 Dexterity AC cap, and add Glancing Blow (reduce one attack's damage by your DEX mod once per round) so it beats Defense Fighting Style.

name: Moderately Armored
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Armor Training
entries: You gain training with Medium armor and {@item Shield|Shields}.

entries.name: Battlefield Readiness
entries: You can don or doff a {@item Shield} as a {@rule Bonus Action}, and you can use a {@item Shield} you are holding as a spellcasting focus for your spells.

changeNote: Restore Shield training, allow any martial ASI, allow using a Shield as a spellcasting focus, and allow donning/doffing a Shield as a Bonus Action.

name: Mounted Combatant
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Mounted Strike
entries: While mounted, you have {@rule Advantage} on attack rolls against any unmounted creature within 5 feet of your mount that is at least one size smaller than the mount. Additionally, mounting or dismounting costs you only 5 feet of movement.

entries.name: Leap Aside
entries: If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if it fails. For your mount to gain this benefit, you must be riding it, and neither of you can have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition.

entries.name: Veer
entries: While mounted, you can force an attack that hits your mount to hit you instead if you don't have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition.

changeNote: Minor buff. Reduce mounting/dismounting cost to 5 feet of movement.

name: Observant
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Keen Observer
entries: Choose one of the following skills: {@skill Insight}, {@skill Investigation}, or {@skill Perception}. If you lack proficiency with the chosen skill, you gain proficiency in it, and if you already have proficiency in it, you gain {@rule Expertise} in it.

entries.name: Quick Search
entries: You can take the {@action Search} action as a {@rule Bonus Action}. Additionally, you have a +5 bonus to your Passive {@skill Perception} and Passive {@skill Investigation} scores. When you succeed on a {@action Search} check to locate a hidden creature, you can call out its position: the creature loses the {@condition Invisible} condition granted by the {@action Hide} action, and the next attack roll made against it by you or an ally before the start of your next turn has {@rule Advantage}.

changeNote: Restore +5 Passive Perception/Investigation and give Quick Search a potential combat use against Hidden creatures.

name: Piercer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Puncture
entries: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Piercing damage, you can reroll one of the attack's damage dice, and you must use the new roll.

entries.name: Enhanced Critical
entries: When you score a {@rule Critical Hit} that deals Piercing damage to a creature, you can roll one additional damage die when determining the extra Piercing damage the target takes.

entries.name: Armor Piercing
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Piercing damage, the attack ignores {@rule Resistance} to Piercing damage, and if you had {@rule Advantage} on the attack roll or beat the target's AC by 5 or more, the attack deals extra Piercing damage equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}.

changeNote: Add Armor Piercing to bring Piercer up to the ~same level as Crusher/Slasher.

name: Poisoner
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Potent Poison
entries: When you make a damage roll that deals Poison damage, it ignores {@rule Resistance} to Poison damage, and creatures with {@rule Immunity} to Poison damage instead treat your Poison damage as though they had {@rule Resistance} to it.

entries.name: Brew Poison
entries: You gain proficiency with the {@item Poisoner's Kit}. When you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, you can craft a number of potent poison doses equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} at no cost (these doses lose potency when you finish your next {@rule Long Rest}). You can also craft an additional batch with 1 hour of work and 25 GP worth of materials. As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you can apply a poison dose to a weapon or piece of ammunition. Once applied, the poison retains its potency for 1 minute or until you deal damage with the poisoned item. When a creature takes damage from the poisoned item, it must make a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 8} plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat and your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, it takes {@damage 2d8} Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned} condition until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much Poison damage only.

changeNote: Treat Poison Immunity as Resistance for your damage, grant a free daily poison dose, and deal half damage on a successful save.

name: Savage Attacker
entries: You've trained to deal particularly devastating strikes, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Ferocious Strikes
entries: Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

entries.name: Go for the Throat
entries: Once per turn when you hit a {@status Bloodied} creature with a weapon, you can add your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} to the damage roll. Additionally, when you score a {@rule Critical Hit} with a weapon, you can roll one additional weapon damage die and add it to the extra damage.

changeNote: Add extra critical damage die and bonus damage vs Bloodied foes so Savage Attacker isn't an embarassment.

name: Sharpshooter
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bypass Cover
entries: Your ranged attacks with weapons ignore {@rule Cover|Half Cover} and {@rule Cover|Three-Quarters Cover}.

entries.name: Firing in Melee
entries: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose {@rule Disadvantage} on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

entries.name: Long Shots
entries: Attacking at long range doesn't impose {@rule Disadvantage} on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

entries.name: Deadeye
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature that is at least 30 feet away from you with a Ranged weapon attack, you can add your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} to the damage roll.

changeNote: Add Deadeye so Sharpshooter pays off in every combat and still competes with other +damage feats.

name: Shield Master
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shield Bash
entries: If you attack a creature within 5 feet of you as part of the {@action Attack} action and hit with a Melee weapon, you can immediately bash the target with your {@item Shield} if it's equipped, forcing the target to make a Strength saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Strength modifier and {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, you either push the target 5 feet from you or cause it to have the {@condition Prone} condition (your choice). You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns.

entries.name: Interpose Shield
entries: If you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and are holding a {@item Shield}.

name: Skill Expert
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Skill Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

entries.name: Expertise
entries: Choose one skill in which you have proficiency but lack {@rule Expertise}. You gain {@rule Expertise} with that skill.

name: Slasher
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hamstring
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Slashing damage, you can reduce the {@rule Speed} of that creature by 10 feet and prevent it from regaining {@rule Hit Points} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Enhanced Critical
entries: When you score a {@rule Critical Hit} that deals Slashing damage to a creature, it has {@rule Disadvantage} on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

changeNote: Minor change. Prevent healing as well on slashing damage.

name: Tavern Brawler
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Enhanced Unarmed Strike
entries: When you hit with your {@rule Unarmed Strike} and deal damage, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to {@damage 1d6} plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an {@rule Unarmed Strike}.

entries.name: Damage Rerolls
entries: Whenever you roll a damage die for your {@rule Unarmed Strike}, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll.

entries.name: Improvised Weaponry
entries: You have proficiency with improvised weapons, and any improvised weapon you wield uses a damage die of at least {@damage 1d6}.

entries.name: Push
entries: When you hit a creature with an {@rule Unarmed Strike} as part of the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can deal damage to the target and also push it 5 feet away from you. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

changeNote: Bump Unarmed Strike and improvised weapon damage to 1d6 so non-Monk brawlers might want it.

name: Telepathic
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Telepathic Utterance
entries: You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Your telepathic utterances are in a language you know, and the creature understands you only if it knows that language. A creature you contact in this way can respond to you telepathically until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Detect Thoughts
entries: You always have the {@spell Detect Thoughts} spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot or spell components, and you must finish a {@rule Long Rest} before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Psychic Warning
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you can flash a telepathic warning to one ally you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Until the start of your next turn, that ally has either {@rule Advantage} on its next saving throw or attackers have {@rule Disadvantage} on the next attack roll made against it (your choice when you use this benefit). You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

changeNote: Make telepathy two-way and add Psychic Warning to bump this up around Telekinetic or spell-based feats you might take.
